title: Tick-type-aware deterministic fallback mappings for T3/T5/T6/T7/T8
objective: Create a new module back/app/engines/appraisal_fallback.py that accepts an AppraisalInput and returns a semantically grounded AppraisalOutput for each of the five deferred tick types (T3=self_initiated_action, T5=emotional_shift, T6=learning_work, T7=player_influence, T8=reflection). Each mapping must produce a non-trivially distinct output that reflects what the tick actually does — not a uniform zero-out — while staying within all AppraisalOutput field bounds. The existing from_deterministic_fallback classmethod on AppraisalOutput (which zero-outs deferred ticks) is not modified; the new module is an independent, richer fallback layer.
exact_scope: One new source file (back/app/engines/appraisal_fallback.py) and one new test file (back/tests/test_p29_t3_appraisal_fallback.py). No other files are touched.
constraints: AppraisalInput schema (back/app/domain/appraisal_input.py) must not be changed.
AppraisalOutput schema (back/app/domain/appraisal_output.py) must not be changed.
No existing engine file, test file, or seed file may be modified.

All returned AppraisalOutput instances must pass AppraisalOutput model validation (field bounds, absorption=none forbids growth, no duplicate growth dimensions, closeness_delta -2 to +2, risk_delta -10 to +10).
fallback_used must be True on every output produced by this module.
confidence must be 1.0 on every output produced by this module (fully deterministic).
tick_type advisory field must be set to the input's tick_type on every output.
The module must not import from tick_bridge.py, day_simulator.py, or any world/ module.
The module must not introduce randomness, I/O, or side effects.
No LLM calls or external API calls.
acceptance_criteria: A public function get_fallback_output(input: AppraisalInput) -> AppraisalOutput exists in back/app/engines/appraisal_fallback.py and is importable.
T3 (self_initiated_action): returns absorption=surface or partial, a non-empty growth list containing at least the expression dimension (toward), aftershock_days=0, relational=None.
T5 (emotional_shift): returns absorption=surface or partial, non-empty growth list containing at least emotional_stability dimension, arousal=medium, aftershock_days=0, relational=None.
T6 (learning_work): returns absorption=partial or deep, non-empty growth list containing at least the curiosity dimension (toward), aftershock_days=0, relational=None.

T7 (player_influence): the output reflects the player's action_type from AppraisalInput.player_context — at minimum two distinct action_type values produce different growth dimensions or guidance_resonance values.
T8 (reflection): returns absorption=surface, a non-empty growth list containing at least the emotional_stability dimension, aftershock_days=0, relational=None.
Every output passes Pydantic model validation (no ValidationError raised).
Every output has fallback_used=True, confidence=1.0, and tick_type set to the input tick_type.
Calling get_fallback_output with T1, T2, or T4 raises ValueError with a message indicating those tick types are not handled by this module (they have their own bridge paths).
The narrative_summary field is non-None and non-empty for every tick type, describing what the fallback represents.
At least 25 tests exist in back/tests/test_p29_t3_appraisal_fallback.py and all pass under python -m pytest tests/ -v.
No existing tests regress (full suite passes).
required_tests: For each of the 5 deferred tick types (T3/T5/T6/T7/T8): one test confirming the output is a valid AppraisalOutput instance.
For each of the 5 deferred tick types: one test confirming fallback_used=True, confidence=1.0, tick_type set correctly.
For each of the 5 deferred tick types: one test confirming absorption is not 'none' (each tick produces a meaningful signal).
For each of the 5 deferred tick types: one test confirming growth list is non-empty and contains the expected primary dimension.

For T7 (player_influence): at least two tests with different ActionType values showing that different action types produce observably different outputs (different growth dimension, different guidance_resonance, or different valence).
For T7 (player_influence): one test confirming that when action_type=reinforce_curiosity the curiosity growth dimension is present.
For T7 (player_influence): one test confirming that when action_type=emotional_stability the emotional_stability growth dimension is present.
One test confirming that calling get_fallback_output with EventCategory.information_exposure raises ValueError.
One test confirming that calling get_fallback_output with EventCategory.social_interaction raises ValueError.
One test confirming that calling get_fallback_output with EventCategory.relationship_shift raises ValueError.
One test confirming the growth list never exceeds 3 entries for any tick type.
One test confirming no duplicate growth dimensions appear in any tick type output.
One test confirming aftershock_days=0 for all 5 deferred tick types.
One test confirming narrative_summary is a non-empty string for all 5 deferred tick types.
non_goals: Do not wire get_fallback_output into any engine call path, day_simulator, or route handler — this is schema and logic definition only.
Do not modify AppraisalOutput.from_deterministic_fallback — that classmethod is a separate, simpler path and must stay unchanged.
Do not activate T3/T5/T6/T7/T8 bridges in tick_bridge.py.
Do not add growth or settlement logic for deferred ticks to appraisal_settlement.py.
Do not introduce any prompt engineering, LLM-facing text templates, or model call stubs.
Do not touch T1, T2, or T4 fallback logic anywhere.
Do not add aftershock_days > 0 for any deferred tick type in this task.
